name: Barajas de Melo (Spain)
description: White field with a green chevron pointing downwards from the upper corners to the middle of the lower edge, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Barajas de Melo (a crescent and crosses of Saint James on white).
history: Municipal flag of Barajas de Melo; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: inverted chevron from the upper corners to the middle of the lower edge
